## Lecture outline

::: {.lec-outline}
::: {.lec-group}
### Time-domain methods

- Time-domain identification methods
- Impulse-response estimation
- Step-response analysis
- Correlation-based estimation with white and colored inputs
:::

::: {.lec-group}
### Frequency-domain methods

- Frequency-domain identification
- Frequency-response analysis
- Empirical transfer function estimation and its properties
:::

::: {.lec-group}
### Spectral estimation

- Spectral estimation
- Welch and Bartlett smoothing methods
- Spectral comparison
:::

::: {.lec-group}
### FRF analysis and implementation

- FRF analysis using averaging and coherence
- MATLAB implementations throughout the lecture
:::

:::
